description: Create a swipeable document post from a PDF (public URL) — the format LinkedIn shows as a page-by-page carousel. LinkedIn is the ONLY platform that renders a PDF: if LinkedIn is not connected the tool returns a connect link, which you should give the user. Instagram can be added when the post is PUBLISHED — the pages then go out there as an image carousel — so one post is created, not two. Provide either a ready caption or a context for AI to write one.

context.description: What the document is about — used to AI-generate the caption if none is given

createCarousel.description: Also create a SEPARATE Instagram carousel post from the pages right now (max 10 slides). Default false — Instagram is normally added at publish time instead.

documentUrl.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the PDF document

title.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document card. Defaults to a readable form of the filename.

name: create_document_post
title: Create Document Post (PDF, LinkedIn only)
